PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
CAMS Certified professional with 15+ years of measurable contribution across UAE and India in KYC Operations, Quality Analysis, Risk Management, and Team Leadership. raw_sections.skills:
CORE COMPETENCIES
Risk Assessment & Controls • Compliance & Client Relationship Management
Quality Management • Team Leadership
Operations & Delivery Management
Project Management
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Associate Program Manager Eclerx Services Limited | Navi Mumbai, India Key Responsibilities:
May 2021 – June 2026
Spearhead KYC/AML operations for global banking clients covering client onboarding and scheduled periodic reviews, consistently meeting internal SLA and quality benchmarks.
Transformed outreach governance by restructuring escalation workflows and expedited senior stakeholder sign-offs on high-risk KYC files.
Established an internal control framework aligning compliance policies, business processes, and regulatory standards.
Implemented automated Macro Checklists that significantly improved process efficiency and quality scores across the team.
Conduct regular training sessions on policy updates, regulatory requirements, and best practices — maintaining 100% completion rates on mandatory trainings.
Perform detailed customer risk profiling (Low / Medium / High) and ongoing transaction monitoring to detect potential money laundering activity.
Serve as primary point of contact for internal/external audits and regulatory investigations; work with Global QA team to maintain consistency with the Global QA framework.
Provide weekly key performance updates to Top Management and Client Officials, covering operational metrics across efficiency, volume, and quality.
Country Site Manager Citicorp Services India Ltd (Client of Wipro Limited) | Pune, India
Oct 2019 – Apr 2021
Key Responsibilities:
Directed a team of 42 onsite staff in delivering KYC/AML services for global investment banking clients across new onboarding, renewals, and remediation projects.
Governed remediation projects and presented progress reports to Senior Management and successfully closed critical projects within agreed timelines.
Led compliance risk assessment efforts measuring inherent and residual risk for U.S. Operations' business activities.
Standardized and optimized Pulse Report dashboard to measure, track, and improve team performance KPIs. • Globally responsible for publishing Monthly Business Review (MBR) reports presented by Management to Citi Global Head.
Improved employee retention by strategically aligning team assignments to individual skill sets.
Country Manager – Middle East Cluster Citigroup Global Market Ltd | Dubai, UAE
Oct 2015 – Sep 2018
Key Responsibilities:
Represented Citi Commercial Bank for the UAE, Bahrain, and Jordan cluster in governance, risk, technology, and change committees.
Strategically led a team performing client onboarding, annual KYC reviews, Enhanced Due Diligence, Name Screening, and regulatory compliance.
Hosted AML call report meetings with Relationship Managers, Business Heads, Compliance, and High-Risk Client stakeholders locally and globally.
Led the unit through Internal Audit, external regulatory reviews, and Compliance testing, consistently achieving management expectations.
Published monthly and quarterly reports for Senior Management on progress across people, process, clients, controls, and technology.
Implemented AML Framework policies and procedures, ensuring alignment with regulatory standards and internal governance requirements.
Manager – Middle East KYC Operations Citigroup Global Market Ltd | Dubai, UAE Key Responsibilities:
Jan 2014 – Sep 2015
Managed the ME Cluster KYC functions including risk management operations, achieving quality and productivity targets.
Supported regional Core functions including Re-Engineering and Business Solutions during Citi KYC Implementation.
Led ME region in KYC projects, liaising with Global KYC BSU Management, Compliance, and Relationship Management.
Conducted UAT and infrastructure readiness for Information Services Group and Citi KYC system releases.
Assistant Manager – KYC Quality Citigroup Global Market Ltd | Dubai, UAE
Jan 2013 – Dec 2013
Key Responsibilities:
Functioned as key Quality Analyst overseeing KYC documentation from initiation to approval. • Collaborated with Relationship Management on client renewals and changes in local/global requirements. • Independently participated in Risk and Control Self-Assessments on AML/Sanctions processes and remediated deficiencies.
Senior Case Manager – UAE Hub Setup Citigroup Global Market Ltd | Dubai, UAE
May 2011 – Dec 2012
Key Responsibilities:
Credited with the complete setup of the new Citi UAE hub covering UAE, Bahrain, Qatar, Kuwait, Egypt, Lebanon, Jordan, and Pakistan.
Implemented AML/KYC policies and procedures as per local and global requirements; performed KYC review and approval.
Researched companies using KYC/AML tools including World Check, Zawya, Dun & Bradstreet, and regulatory websites.
EARLIER CAREER
Citigroup, Mumbai, India
Senior Case Manager — Dec 2009 – Apr 2011 • Team Leader, Risk & Data Analytics — Sep 2008 – Nov 2009
AWARDS & RECOGNITION
Service Excellence Award from CEO, Citigroup UAE — exceptional delivery of services to Relationship Managers (2011)
Best Business Partner Award — Citi Bank Diversity Celebration (2016) • Excellent People Engagement Award (2022) • Best Team of the Year Award (2023) • Certificate of Recognition for exceptional contribution to KYC Process Transformation (2025).
